verify.offline: The verify service is not answering just now. Nothing was stored. Try again in a minute.

verify.manifestInvalid: The Content Credentials inside this file fail validation: the file was changed after signing, or the record was copied in from another file. The fingerprints matched anyway.
verify.manifestUnreadable: This file carries Content Credentials we could not read, so we cannot say whether they hold. The fingerprints matched anyway.
verify.manifestCredentialExpired: The signature is intact. The certificate that made it has since expired.
verify.manifestCredentialUntrusted: The signature is intact. The certificate that made it is not one this check trusts.

attestations.heading: Checked again, by someone else
attestations.empty: No check has been written for this passport yet. Chainlink's workflow writes one when it checks the picture.
attestations.receiver: Written on Monad by Moolam's Chainlink receiver
attestations.body: Anyone can say a picture is theirs. This part is different: Chainlink's CRE workflow downloaded the picture itself, took its fingerprint again and wrote the result on Monad.

attestations.byTestRun: A test run in Chainlink's simulator

attestations.noTransaction: The transaction link is not available for this one yet.
attestations.verdict: A Chainlink CRE workflow re-fetched this picture and recomputed its fingerprint: <apart>{bits} of 64 bits apart</apart>.
attestations.gridNote: The first grid is the fingerprint the registry stored when this picture was registered. The second is what the workflow computed from the file it fetched itself. Every cell that disagrees is marked.
attestations.whatIsRecheck: A check is a Chainlink CRE workflow fetching this file for itself, computing the fingerprint again and writing that answer on Monad. Nobody can write one about their own picture.

private.lead: Checked privately by a Chainlink confidential workflow, from the small copy Moolam keeps.
private.leadEarlier: Checked privately by a Chainlink confidential workflow, from the small copy Moolam kept at the time.
private.limit: It ran in Chainlink's simulator on one machine, not inside Chainlink's secure hardware.
private.verdict: A Chainlink confidential workflow opened the small private copy Moolam kept of this picture and compared its fingerprint: <apart>{bits} of 64 bits apart</apart>.
private.gridNote: The first grid is the fingerprint the registry stored when this picture was registered. The second is what the workflow computed from Moolam's small private copy. Every cell that disagrees is marked.

attestations.sealedBody: Anyone can say a picture is theirs. This part is different: a second party checks the fingerprint and writes the answer on Monad. A sealed picture has no public file, so its check is private: when its creator asked for one, a Chainlink confidential workflow opens the small private copy Moolam keeps and compares the fingerprint.

unknown.lead: Written on Monad by an unknown writer
unknown.verdict: An unknown writer reported this fingerprint for the picture: <apart>{bits} of 64 bits apart</apart>.
unknown.gridNote: The first grid is the fingerprint the registry stored when this picture was registered. The second is the one this writer reported. Moolam does not know who runs this writer, so this page does not say how the picture was checked.

signer.policy: This permission can only add edits to your passports.
signer.granting: Privy is asking for your permission
signer.granted: This app can add edits from your wallet

done.feeSponsored: Sponsored by Privy. You paid nothing.

failure.notOwner: This account does not hold this passport, so it cannot add an edit to it.
failure.noParent: The registry has no passport with this id, so there is nothing to add an edit to.
failure.quota: That is {used} of {limit} edits for today. The allowance comes back at {at}.
failure.sendFailed: The registry refused the edit, so nothing was recorded.
failure.sendPending: The edit went out and the service could not see it land in time. It may still be on its way, so it must not be sent again. Ask Monad again in a moment.
failure.dependencyDown: A service this edit needs did not answer, so nothing was sent and nothing was spent. Try again in a minute.
failure.signFailed: Privy would not sign the send, so nothing was recorded.
failure.pinFailed: The edited picture could not be pinned to IPFS, so nothing was sent.
failure.busy: The service is running as many edits at once as it can. Try again in a moment.
failure.offline: The verify service did not answer, so nothing was sent.
failure.signedOut: This session is signed out, so the service would not take the edit.
failure.tooLarge: That file is over the 20 MB limit. Choose a smaller copy.
failure.fingerprintUnstable: This edit changes too little from side to side for a fingerprint that survives copying, so Chainlink's check and any search for its copies would miss it. Nothing was pinned or sent. An edit with more detail across its width will register.
failure.signedFileTooLarge: Adding the passport's signature would take this file past 20 MB, the most a check can read back. Export it smaller and try again. Nothing was pinned or sent.
failure.thumbnailTooLarge: This picture cannot be reduced to a thumbnail small enough for Chainlink's check to fetch, so its passport could never be checked. Nothing was pinned or sent.
failure.notAnImage: That is not an image file. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
failure.empty: That file is empty. Choose the picture again.
failure.rateLimited: Too many requests from here for now. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.badRequest: The service turned the request down.
failure.badResponse: The service answered in a shape this app does not know.
failure.confirmPending: The edit was accepted and Monad has not shown it yet. It may still land, so it must not be sent again.
failure.titleMissing: Give the edit a title first.
failure.grantDeclined: The permission was not given, so this app still cannot add edits.
failure.grantFailed: Privy could not add the signer to your wallet.
failure.alreadyRegistered: This exact image is already registered. The first registration wins, so open the passport that holds it.
failure.unknown: The edit did not go through.
failure.serviceFault: This was a fault on Moolam's side, not a problem with your picture. Nothing was saved. Try again in a minute.

platform.outsideKit: This wallet is listed as {platform}, but this picture was registered outside the Moolam platform kit.

passport.noAgent: No generating agent. This one was registered from a file the creator uploaded.

dispute.body: Someone put a bond behind a claim that this record is wrong. The bond is held by the registry until the dispute is settled.
dispute.evidenceElsewhere: The evidence for this challenge points somewhere else:
dispute.waiting: Waiting for the dispute judge to decide.

outcome.open: Waiting for the dispute judge to decide.
outcome.upheld: The resolver agreed with the challenge. The bond went back to the challenger, and this record is marked disputed for good.
outcome.rejected: The resolver did not agree. The bond went to the treasury, and the record stands.

flag.heading: Put a bond behind the claim
flag.what: A dispute costs a bond of {bond} MON. The resolver named by the policy settles it, and if they agree with you, the bond is credited back to you.
flag.whatUnknown: A dispute costs a bond, and the policy contract sets how much. The resolver named by the policy settles it, and if they agree with you, the bond is credited back to you.
flag.fee: Moolam pays the network fee. It cannot pay the bond: that is your own MON, and it leaves your account the moment this lands.
flag.reasonLabel: What is wrong with this record
flag.reasonPlaceholder: Say what you know, and how somebody else could check it.
flag.reasonHint: Between {min} and {max} characters. It travels inside the transaction, so it is public and permanent.
flag.signedOut: Challenging takes a Moolam account and the bond from your own wallet. Reading the rules takes neither.

account.waiting: Your account puts up the bond
account.done: Your account put up the bond
account.failed: Your account did not put up the bond

send.watching: Waiting for Monad to show it
send.unconfirmed: Sent, and Monad has not shown it yet

done.label: Recorded
done.heading: The challenge is on the record
done.body: This passport now says it is challenged, to everybody who opens it, until the resolver settles it.
done.bondHeldBody: Held by the registry itself until the dispute is settled. Nobody can move it.

failure.reasonShort: Say a little more. A challenge needs at least {min} characters, so the resolver has something to check.
failure.reasonLong: That is over {max} characters. All of it goes on chain, so keep the part that matters.
failure.notEnough: Your account is {short} MON short of the bond. Moolam pays the network fee, but the bond has to be your own MON.
failure.badBond: The bond changed while this panel was open, so the registry refused this amount. It has been read again, so try once more.
failure.alreadyOpen: Somebody has already challenged this passport, and the registry allows one open dispute at a time.
failure.alreadyDisputed: This passport is already marked disputed, so it cannot be challenged again.
failure.notFound: The registry has no passport with this id.
failure.paused: New records and new challenges are paused on the registry right now.
failure.declined: The window was closed before the transaction went out. Nothing was sent and nothing was spent.
failure.confirmPending: The challenge was accepted and Monad has not shown it yet. It may still land, so it must not be sent again.
failure.notResolver: Only the resolver named by the policy can settle a dispute.
failure.noOpenDispute: There is no open dispute on this passport.

line.open: The holder allows all four uses in the standard, training included.
line.closed: The holder refuses all four uses in the standard. This is a choice, not a fault.
line.ask: The holder allows these uses only on their own conditions. Anyone who cannot ask has to read it as no.
line.mixed: This statement answers each use on its own terms.
line.none: Nobody has written a statement for this picture yet. Nothing stated is not permission.

consent.fourUsesNote: What stands today, use by use. Every summary loses something, and this is where training and inference are allowed to differ.

failure.conditionsNotPrintable: Use only the letters A to Z, numbers and common punctuation. Take out the line break or the accented letter and send it again.
failure.reverted: Monad mined this statement and it did nothing. Nothing was written, so it is safe to try once more.
failure.declined: You closed the prompt, so nothing was sent.
failure.confirmPending: The statement went out and Monad has not shown it yet. It may still land, so it must not be sent again: look again in a moment.
failure.unknown: The statement did not go through.

done.check: Anyone can fetch the picture, hash it and compare it with the passport id on Monad. That is the whole proof, and it needs nothing from this service.

signs.body: An agent's name is only as good as the account behind it. The registry checks that link itself, on every registration, before it writes anything.

own.body: That signer is checked against the owner listed in the public agent registry (ERC-8004). If they differ, Monad refuses the registration and no passport is made.

switch.note: Moolam publishes the passport, not the picture. Save the file we hand back: it is the only copy that can unseal this passport.

mark.label: Trust mark

upheld.line: Moolam upheld a challenge against this record. Treat it, and its AI-use terms, as wrong.

mismatch.line: Chainlink's network fetched the picture this passport points to, and it is not the picture that was registered.

lookalike.line: An earlier passport, {title}, looks like the same picture. It was registered on {date}, before this one.

challenged.line: Someone put {bond} MON behind a claim that this record is wrong. The holder can answer until {date}.

waiting.line: Registered {when}. Chainlink's network checks every new public passport, and has not checked this one yet.

checked.line: Chainlink's network fetched this picture itself, measured it again, and it matches its passport: {bits} of 64 bits apart. Written on Monad on {date}.

sealed.line: Never published, so Chainlink's network cannot check it. Its fingerprints are public, and a copy still finds it in Verify.
sealed.lineTestRun: Never published, so Chainlink's network cannot check it. The private test run listed below ran in Chainlink's simulator, and a copy still finds it in Verify.

nothing.line: This passport names no picture, so Chainlink has nothing to fetch.

mark.secondPrint: Chainlink's network found the look fingerprint matches and the layout fingerprint does not. Both have to match, so this passport does not pass.

simulator.line: A test run on one machine, in Chainlink's simulator. It stays in the record and never turns on the mark.

mark.unread: The mark could not be read just now, so none is shown. Try again in a moment.

claim.label: Where the claim comes from
claim.studio: Made in Moolam's studio. The agent signed the picture the moment it was drawn.
claim.platform: Drawn on {platform}. Its agent signed the picture the moment it was made.
claim.camera: A camera signed this picture when it was taken. That names a camera, not a person.
claim.self: Uploaded by {address} on {date}. That is their claim, open to challenge until {until}.
claim.selfLater: Uploaded by {address} on {date}. That is their claim, and anyone can still challenge it with evidence.
claim.outside: Registered outside Moolam's studio: no sworn statement, no web check.
claim.beforeSworn: Registered before the sworn line existed, so it carries no sworn statement.
claim.kitNoStatement: Registered through the platform kit. {platform} sent no statement of its own, and a platform's picture is not checked against the web.
claim.cosigned: Signed by {person} with their own passkey on {platform}, {date}. {platform}'s agent signed the same picture.
claim.seenEarlier: Before signing, they were shown an earlier passport like this one.

found.heading: Earlier passport found
found.line: Chainlink's network measured this picture itself and found {title}, registered on {date}, {bits} of 64 bits apart. Written on Monad on {at}.

searching.heading: Earlier passport, not confirmed yet
searching.line: Moolam's search found an earlier passport like this: {title}, registered on {date}. Chainlink has not confirmed it yet.

lookalike.order: Registered first is not the same as made first. Anyone can challenge either passport with evidence.

later.line: A later passport looks the same: {title}, registered on {date}.
later.count: {count, plural, =1 {# later passport looks} other {# later passports look}} the same.

lookalike.none: Chainlink found no earlier look-alike among the candidates Moolam's search proposed.
lookalike.sealed: An earlier sealed passport carries a fingerprint like this picture's. Its picture was never shown, so nobody can compare the two.

sworn.label: By signing, you state
sworn.line: I made this picture, or I hold the rights to register it.
sworn.note: This line goes into the passport you sign, for anyone to read.

rules.heading: What a challenge needs
rules.earlier: The earlier work: the picture you say this passport copies.
rules.proof: Proof it existed or was shown earlier: a dated post, the camera's own file, or an earlier passport.
rules.verify: A Verify answer that shows it is the same picture.
rules.licensed: That it is not a copy you licensed to them.
rules.burden: The challenger carries the burden. Without this evidence, the record stands.

decider.who: Moolam decides challenges today, by these rules, and publishes every decision with its reasons. Moolam is one company, not a court.
decider.seat: The decider is one address named on Monad. Changing it takes a public 24 hour wait.
decider.bond: A rejected challenge's bond is burned, so Moolam gains nothing either way.
decider.heading: Who decides
decider.treasury: A rejected challenge's bond is credited to the treasury the policy names, {treasury}.

answer.heading: Answer this challenge
answer.prompt: Someone has challenged your passport. You have until {date} to answer before Moolam decides. Say why the record is right, and how someone else could check it.
answer.placeholder: What you know, and how someone else could check it.
answer.hint: Up to 4,000 bytes. Your wallet signs it, and it is pinned for good where anyone can read it.

states.signing: Waiting for your wallet to sign
states.done: Your answer is pinned and shown on this passport.

shown.label: The holder's answer
shown.none: The holder has not answered yet. They have until {date}.
shown.missed: The holder did not answer within the 14 days.
shown.unread: The holder's answer could not be read just now. Try again in a moment.

refusals.noOpenDispute: There is no open challenge on this passport to answer.
refusals.windowClosed: The 14 days to answer this challenge have passed.
refusals.expired: Your signature ran out before it arrived. Sign again.
refusals.noHolder: Monad shows no holder for this passport, so nobody can answer for it.
refusals.notHolder: This wallet does not hold this passport, so it cannot answer for it.
refusals.signatureUsed: That signature was already used. Sign again.
refusals.alreadyAnswered: This challenge already has its answer. Each challenge takes one.
refusals.answering: An answer to this challenge is being sent from another window. Look again in a moment.
refusals.unavailable: Moolam cannot take answers right now. Nothing was sent. Try again later.
refusals.chainUnreachable: Moolam could not read Monad just now. Nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
refusals.pinFailed: Your answer could not be pinned, so nothing was saved. Try again.
refusals.busy: Too many answers are arriving right now. Wait a minute and try again.
refusals.tooLong: Your answer is over 4,000 bytes. Shorten it and sign again.
refusals.notPrintable: Hidden characters cannot be sent. Take them out and sign again.
refusals.declined: You closed the wallet prompt, so nothing was signed.
refusals.unknown: The answer did not go through.

decision.heading: The decision
decision.upheld: Upheld on {date}. Moolam agreed with the challenge.
decision.noReasons: No reasons were published with this decision.
decision.upheldUndated: Upheld. Moolam agreed with the challenge.
decision.unread: The published reasons could not be read just now. Try again in a moment.

held.heading: {count, plural, =1 {A picture you hold is challenged} other {# pictures you hold are challenged}}

publish.label: The reasons
publish.placeholder: What the evidence showed, which rule decided it, and how anyone can check it.
publish.hint: Up to 8,000 bytes, line breaks kept. Your wallet signs them, and they are pinned for good where anyone can read them.
publish.button: Sign and publish, one more transaction
publish.why: Settling wrote the outcome on Monad, not the reasons. Publishing them is one more transaction from this wallet: it writes the pinned reasons' address beside this decision, so anyone who opens the passport can read why.

states.signing: Waiting for your wallet to sign the reasons
states.pending: The publish went out and no receipt shows it yet. It may still land, so it must not be sent again.

publish.done: Published. Monad's receipt carries this decision's reasons, and the passport page links them.

refusals.tooLong: The reasons are over 8,000 bytes. Shorten them and sign again.
refusals.notPrintable: Hidden characters cannot be sent. Take them out and sign again.
refusals.expired: Your signature ran out before it arrived. Sign again.
refusals.notResolver: This wallet is not the resolver the policy names, so nothing was pinned or sent.
refusals.notSettled: Monad does not show this dispute settled, so it has no decision to explain yet.
refusals.mismatch: Monad shows this dispute settled another way or opened at another time. Reload the desk and look again.
refusals.alreadyPublished: The reasons for this decision are already published.
refusals.pinning: These reasons are being pinned from another window. Look again in a moment.
refusals.busy: Too many reasons were pinned today, or too many requests came at once. Try again later.
refusals.pinFailed: The reasons could not be pinned, so nothing was published. Send them again.
refusals.unavailable: Moolam cannot pin reasons right now. Nothing was published. Try again later.
refusals.chainUnreachable: Monad could not be read just now. Nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
refusals.declined: You closed the wallet prompt, so nothing was signed or sent.
refusals.invalidAddress: MoolamDecisions would not take this address, so nothing was sent.
refusals.reverted: Monad mined the publish and its receipt does not carry these reasons. Nothing was published.
refusals.unknown: The publish did not go through.
